action_space: CLICK x y (0..1000 normalized) | TYPE text | KEY name | DONE

tasks.name: wizard-sum
tasks.instruction: A 4-step wizard shows a number on each step. Go through all four steps reading each number, then on the final screen enter the SUM of all four numbers and click Submit.
tasks.target: submitted == 1 and typed == n1+n2+n3+n4 (recomputed in Python)

tasks.name: distractor-buttons
tasks.instruction: Three buttons look identical. Click the one whose label matches the Target shown above (Option A/B/C). Clicking a wrong button counts as a mistake.

tasks.name: hidden-value
tasks.instruction: A code is shown. Click 'Hide code' to hide it, then enter the code from memory into the field and click Submit.
tasks.target: submitted == 1 and typed == code (recomputed from body dataset)

tasks.name: keyboard-nav
tasks.instruction: Use Arrow keys to move the focus in the 3x3 grid, then press Enter on the target cell to select it (the action to write is: KEY enter). You may also click the target cell directly.

tasks.name: undo-redo
tasks.instruction: Fill all three fields, then click Undo twice to remove the last two entries, then click Save. Final state: only field 1 has text.
tasks.target: saved == 1 and f2=='' and f3=='' and f1!=''

tasks.name: multi-filter
tasks.instruction: Apply both filters (red color AND large size) to narrow the list, then click the remaining item (Apple) and Submit.
tasks.target: submitted == 1 and picked == 'Apple' and f1==1 and f2==1

tasks.name: compute
tasks.instruction: Compute A + B from the two numbers shown, type the result, and click Submit.
tasks.target: submitted == 1 and typed == A+B (recomputed in Python)

tasks.name: distractor-list
tasks.instruction: Two lists look alike. Pick the target item from the target list (shown above), then Submit.
